correctness.rationale: Position reset rate r=ck with orientation clock independent: in stationarity Y_k(t)=k int_0^{A_k(t)}exp(-ks)U_{t-s}ds where A_k~Exp(ck) independent of orientation history. Freezing heading yields Z_k=U_t(1-exp(-k A_k)), and angular chord estimates give L2 error <=(2D_R+4h)/k. Scaling E=k A_k~Exp(c) shows radial R=1-exp(-E) has Beta(1,c) law and is independent of U_t; stationary orientation Fourier coefficients h/(h+D_R j²). On fast times s/k the age PDMP R_s has Cov(R0,Rs)=nu exp(-(1+c)s), with mu=1/(1+c), nu=c/((1+c)^2(2+c)); at fixed physical times recent reset ages become independent, giving mu²[m²+(1-m²)exp(-(h+D_R)t)], m=h/(h+D_R). Different zero-lag limits differ by nu>0. Exact symbolic stationary generator equations and k→infinity moment limits independently checked.
